svg.aria-label: De Stijl gig poster: black grid with red, yellow, blue and off-white blocks. Pale Light Promotions presents Carver & the Flood, with support from Mena Grace. Friday 19th September, doors 7:30pm, The Anchor Rooms, 14 Tallow Lane, Bristol WX4 2JQ. Tickets 12 pounds advance, 15 pounds on the door. All ages, bar until midnight.
